core: Mitochondrial apoptosis initiation by BCL-2 family proteins
qualifier: BH3-only and BAX/BAK activation at mitochondria
name: BH3-only and BAX/BAK activation at mitochondria
rationale: All members are BCL-2-family steps (BH3-only BAD/NOXA/PUMA translocation, BAX/BAK oligomerization, BCL-2 inactivation) driving cytochrome c release, upstream of the apoptosome/SMAC and p53-transcriptional events in the confusables.

qualifier: hypoxia/HIF oxygen sensing and lactate fermentation
name: Hypoxia/HIF control of glycolytic flux and fermentation
rationale: Members combine HIF oxygen sensing and hypoxia, p53/mTORC1 metabolic control, fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and lactate fermentation; the HIF/hypoxia and fermentation arms separate it from NFE2L2, FOXO and plain glucose-catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: positive and negative regulation of JNK and p38
name: Positive and negative regulation of JNK and p38 cascades
rationale: Every member regulates JNK or p38 stress kinase activity in either direction (including TAK1-mediated activation), unlike the confusables centred on AP-1, ERK feedback or NOD receptor signaling.

qualifier: EGFR/ERBB family receptors
name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB receptors
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB sorting that terminate EGFR, ERBB2:ERBB3 and ERBB4 signaling, distinguishing it from MET/PTK6 signaling and from general ESCRT membrane-fission themes.

qualifier: NOD1/NOD2 pathway regulation
name: NOD1/NOD2 receptor signaling regulation
rationale: All three members are NOD1, NOD2 or NLR signaling-pathway terms, whereas the confusables add peptidoglycan/MDP responses, inflammasome, NF-kB/IKK recruitment or TLR cytokine outputs.

qualifier: trans-synaptic adhesion organizers on both pre- and postsynaptic sides
name: Trans-synaptic adhesion-driven pre- and postsynaptic assembly
rationale: Members span neurexin-neuroligin, SALM and receptor-type PTP adhesion, pre- and postsynaptic membrane assembly and PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering, while confusables focus on inhibitory GABA receptor clustering or general neuronal adhesion.

qualifier: osteoclast fusion and differentiation
name: Osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption
rationale: All members regulate osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, fusion or bone resorption/remodeling, separating it from macrophage M-CSF signaling, macrophage fusion and osteoblast themes.

qualifier: alditol interconversion with fructose
name: Alditol (polyol) and fructose metabolism
rationale: Members are alditol synthesis and breakdown plus fructose metabolism, the sugar-alcohol (polyol) route, unlike the pentose-phosphate, xylulose, gluconeogenesis and glycerolipid neighbours.

qualifier: CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of nascent actin and tubulin
rationale: All three members are CCT/TRiC chaperonin binding and folding of newly made proteins (actin, tubulin), distinct from generic or ER folding and from aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: GLUT4 membrane targeting and insulin receptor turnover
name: Insulin-stimulated GLUT4 membrane targeting and insulin receptor turnover
rationale: Members cover GLUT4 translocation (RHOQ, protein targeting to membrane), insulin-stimulated glucose import and insulin receptor recycling/insulin catabolism, which confusables centred on adiponectin, IRS/AKT2 or fatty-acid control lack.

core: Regulation of T cell activation and tolerance
qualifier: dendritic cell costimulation and differentiation
name: Dendritic cell-T cell costimulation and tolerance induction
rationale: Members regulate T cell activation, costimulation, anergy, Treg induction and Th1/Th17 restraint together with dendritic cell differentiation and activation, which the T cell-, NK- and cytokine-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: tangential migration and cortical regionalization
name: Cortical regionalization and tangential interneuron migration
rationale: Members are tangential migration of cortical GABAergic and olfactory bulb interneuron precursors plus cortical regionalization, unlike confusables about radial glia-guided migration, commissures or cerebellum.

qualifier: TRKB/TRKC driven by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4
name: TRKB and TRKC neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling
rationale: Members are BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of NTRK2/NTRK3 and their RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2, ERK5 and CREB outputs, whereas confusables centre on NGF/TRKA and p75NTR signaling.

qualifier: negative regulation of IL-4/5/13 and IgE switching
name: Restraint of type 2 cytokines and IgE class switching
rationale: Members are negative regulation of IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 and immunoglobulin production, IgE isotype switching and mast cell cytokines, opposite to the positive Th2, IL-33 and eosinophil confusables.

qualifier: autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosomal fusion
name: Autophagosome assembly, maturation and lysosomal fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and its fusion with lysosomes (including late endosome/MVB fusion), distinct from selective mitophagy/pexophagy and phagosome fusion confusables.

qualifier: sphingoid base, ceramide and sphingomyelin rather than glycosphingolipids
name: Sphingolipid synthesis, turnover and ceramide homeostasis
rationale: Members cover de novo sphingoid/sphingomyelin synthesis, sphingolipid catabolism and ceramide homeostasis, unlike glycosphingolipid, TNFR1 ceramide signaling or lipid-transfer confusables.

qualifier: Rab/ARF GTPase control of recycling and tubulation
name: Rab/ARF-regulated endosomal recycling, tubulation and Golgi budding
rationale: Members link Rab-GAP and ARF signaling to endocytic and receptor recycling, endosome tubulation and Golgi budding/constitutive secretion, which confusables on COPII/flippases or Golgi positioning lack.

core: Activity-dependent kinase signaling to the nucleus
qualifier: both CaMKK/CaMKIV and cAMP/PKA arms, plus AMPK
name: CaMKK/CaMKIV and PKA signaling to CREB and AMPK
rationale: Members are CREB phosphorylation via CaMKIV and adenylate cyclase/PKA, forskolin response and CaMKK-AMPK activation downstream of NMDARs; combining both arms separates it from memory/plasticity, adenylate cyclase-only and MECP2 confusables.

core: Early embryonic neural and axial morphogenesis
qualifier: Hedgehog/GLI and Wnt planar cell polarity signaling
name: Hedgehog and Wnt/PCP signaling in neurulation and axial patterning
rationale: Members combine Hedgehog/SMO/GLI processing and Wnt-PCP convergent extension with neural plate, notochord, floor plate and axial mesoderm development, which neural-plate border, Wnt-calcium and left-right confusables lack.

qualifier: retina, optic cup and optic nerve rather than lens/cornea
name: Embryonic retina, optic cup and optic nerve morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover retina layering and neuron differentiation, optic cup/nerve morphogenesis, RGC axon guidance, iris, eyelid and pigmentation, unlike lens/cornea, photoreceptor-maintenance or inner-ear confusables.

qualifier: multivesicular body, exosome and viral budding
name: ESCRT-mediated membrane fission in MVBs, exosomes and viral budding
rationale: All members involve ESCRT-driven membrane fission (MVB/exosome biogenesis, HIV/viral budding, nuclear envelope sealing), unlike receptor-downregulation, autophagy or cytokinetic-abscission confusables.

qualifier: cell density sensing
name: Hippo signaling and cell density sensing
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway signaling and its positive/negative regulation plus detection of cell density, whereas confusables are adherens-junction and EMT themes.

qualifier: PSD maintenance, receptor delivery and local translation
name: Postsynaptic structural plasticity, receptor delivery and local translation
rationale: Members cover postsynapse assembly and PSD maintenance, postsynaptic actin, receptor transport to the postsynaptic membrane, synaptic translation and long-term plasticity, unlike dendrite/spine morphogenesis confusables.

qualifier: PARP ADP-ribosylation, fork reversal and DNA topology
name: PARP-linked replication fork stress and DNA topology responses
rationale: Members combine poly/auto/de-ADP-ribosylation, fork reversal, DNA topological change, R-loop and DNA-protein crosslink repair and responses to replication-stalling drugs, unlike the homologous recombination, NHEJ and Fanconi confusables.

qualifier: tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ synthesis and mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport
name: Kynurenine-route NAD+ metabolism and mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange
rationale: Members are tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate de novo NAD+ synthesis, nicotinate salvage and NAD(P) turnover plus mitochondrial ATP/ADP/NAD transport and phosphocreatine, separating it from CoA, PDH and polyamine confusables.
